fusions.name: Staghorn Scrape
fusions.desc: A weapon strike that deals 12 damage and makes the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. Your afflictions on the target spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Salt in the Cut
fusions.desc: A flurry of bites that deals 4 water damage to every enemy within 2.5 tiles, rising by 10% for each affliction the target carries, up to 40%.

fusions.name: Low-Tide Refuge
fusions.desc: Hops you 2 tiles and restores 15 health to you and every ally within 3.5 tiles. The healing rises by 1% for each 1% of cast speed you have.

fusions.name: Encrusting Colony
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on that enemy, up to 8. When it reaches 8, they all spend at once: a blow strikes that enemy for 20% of your weapon damage per stack (163% at full). Unfed, a stack fades every 4 seconds.
